The tilt does not change - it was already bearish - but the confidence does, from 5.5 to 6.5, because the three things midday said would decide the session all resolved bearish inside six hours. overnightRisk: Three specific catalysts sit inside the gap before the next report at ~02:00 COT, and they compound rather than cancel. FIRST, the US CPI release: QQQ and VOO both closed at or near the bottom of their 21-day ranges today - VOO at the 0th percentile, its lowest close of the month - with the tape reporting September rate-hike odds above 70 percent going into the print. BTC has tracked the equity risk bid all week; a hot number lands on a market that has already lost its daily EMA20. SECOND, the ETF tape: the 10 September row is MINUS 258.2 million with IBIT still showing a dash, meaning the largest fund has not reported and the final figure can only get worse or stay the same, never better. Three consecutive negative days with the third more than double the second is the worst flow sequence since 28 August. THIRD, and the one that decides how far a move travels: the flush at 76,500 was 99.2 percent long liquidations, 1,087,252 USD of them, and it cleared the shelf WITHOUT reducing crowding - open interest is 2,242,287,825 USD, down only 0.59 percent from midday, and the account ratio is 1.55. Emptied liquidity below plus undiminished leverage above is the exact configuration that turns a 200-point break into a 1,000-point one, and the 76,464.7 to 76,261.0 pocket has no measured resting bids in it. Against all that, the one honest counterweight: 1H RSI is 28.86 and 4H RSI 27.51, both the most oversold readings of the week, and 15m RSI printed a bullish divergence at the low. Oversold markets gap up too. That is why the response is a resting stop at 76,240.0 rather than a flat book - the overnight is not a view, it is a gap, and the only protection that works while nobody is watching is an order that is already sitting there.

divergences.note: The 23:00Z fifteen-minute bar bottomed at 76,489.0 with RSI 24.4; the 23:15Z bar made a LOWER low at 76,464.7 but RSI turned UP to 36.1. Price down 24.3 points, oscillator up 11.7 - a textbook bullish divergence, and it is the only constructive signal measured anywhere in this report. Two honest caveats: it is a two-bar divergence on the fastest frame, which is the weakest form there is, and it has produced a 310.1-point bounce that has not reclaimed a single moving average on any timeframe. Treat it as the reason the resting stop sits at 76,240.0 rather than at 76,450.0 - room for the bounce to fail once without being stopped out of the core.

calibration.rollingRecord: Midday 10 September went 0-for-2 in the direction it wanted and 2-for-2 on the gates resolving cleanly, which is the distinction worth keeping. The 76,680.0 reduce gate FIRED: the 23:00Z hourly closed 76,570.0, 110.0 points through, after eleven hours of holding. The 77,659.4 add gate did NOT fire - the session high reached 77,410.9, missing by 248.5 points, and the best settled hourly close was 77,349.9, missing by 309.5. The 76,261.0 invalidation was never tested; the low was 203.7 points above it. Midday declined the resting stop at 76,680.0 and that declining was WRONG by 205.3 points - the stop would have filled and spot marks below it. Broader record: yesterday's endday went 4-for-4, today's morning 1-for-2, today's midday 2-for-2 on resolution but wrong on direction.
calibration.note: acting_helped is FALSE and it is the second false in a row, so the pattern deserves naming rather than another apology. Midday ADDED 15.00 USDT of spot at 77,423.1 on the strength of a fired add gate, and spot now marks 76,774.8 - 648.3 points and 0.84 percent offside, roughly -0.13 USDT on that tranche. The reasoning midday gave was correct as far as it went: a written gate had fired and the desk was busy contradicting it, and obeying written gates is the rule this desk earned the hard way. What the rule does not say, and what today adds, is WHICH gate to obey when the report contains two. Midday inherited a reduce gate at 76,680.0 and an add gate at 77,056.0 from morning, both live, and it chose to act on the one that agreed with the bounce it was watching. The reduce gate then fired seven hours later and the add is underwater. Note also the symmetry with this morning: morning's REDUCE at 76,954.5 was scored as a loss by midday because spot had bounced to 77,423.1; spot is now 76,774.8, so that reduce is 179.7 points IN THE MONEY and the scoring was premature. The transferable rule is about horizon, not direction: a six-hour window is too short to grade a position-sized decision, and when a report holds gates pointing both ways, the one that protects the book is the one to act on first. This session obeys the reduce that fired.
